title: Best app to track your daily habits
author: karan kanguri

title: Option to sort habits needed.
body: Simplicity at its best! Simple and neat interface. Please provide an option to arrange and then lock the habits added, according to one’s preference. This way most of the habits can be tracked in order. Apart from this it’s an awesome app. Keep up the good work
author: Prashobh Thannickal

title: Poor data syncing abilities
body:
Facing some sync issues while using the app across iPhone iPad and Apple Watch Also i feel it will be more useful if some of the habits can be hidden once achieved for that particular day I don’t think people will be only happy about following 5 to 6 habits in a day. If followed religiously and sincerely then this app can be a life changer 

Regards 
Prasad Gangan
author: prasadgangan

title: Clean and nice
body: Reminders are a Bit confusing. Not quite sure when a notification would popup.
author: Vijay Veluri

title: Love this!
body: Simple, no fuss, very easy to use, and the best thing is that i can add as many habits as i want- way better than the other apps there!
author: Pskay123

title: Saving my day
body: I am getting more value from each day after using this app
author: Anand65

title: Neat and Perfect
body:
Been searching for such habit apps for long and finally found it! Feels like it’s made for me only. Free version does pretty much everything for you. Track multiple habits (there is not limit with the free version - I mean freaking wooow), break a bad habit, segregate by time, simple marking done or not just by swiping left/right. 

I’m just going to get the premium version to support the developers, and even that’s lifetime and pretty cheap! Steal deal !

title: Simple. Clean.
body:
I love the fact that this app is easy to use has all the necessary features and not cluttered with frills and fancies. 
Also get the full version as it is cheap and a one time purchase.

title: Best budget app with one time fee
body: One of the best habit tracker apps with a full screen view. Also economical as charged only a one time fee. Keep the good work. One recommendation for the next update. Please make a way to arrange the habits as per ones wish’s as right now we cannot change the same
